GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is chosen when users want to ensure summarized data aligns with the underlying Salesforce records.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the user requests validation of summarized data, use the EmployeeCopilot__validateSegmentMember action to check data consistency.
If discrepancies are found, suggest corrective actions but do not apply changes.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only validate that summarized data is consistent with the underlying Salesforce records. You aren't able to make changes to the data.
